Flow.description:
Gitlab #30528 This flow have been created as part of Workflow Rule conversion but this can be used for all before create & update opportunity scenarios. Workflow Rules Converted into the flows are "Avoid delimiter from Account Name during lead conversion", "IME Owner Manager Email Update", "Opportunity Lost Update", "Inactive Pipeline Flag", "Stage 5 - Sent to NCSP Age","Opportunity Rule for Email Updates", "IME_First_Added_to_Forecast" & "IME Forecast Last Modified".
#35878 - CRM: Merge existing Flows (6Sense Buying Stage Field Update, Active Pipeline Flag and AWS Deal Registration Notification (remove the cloud provider decision check, Opportunity Stage Date and Band Updates) with Opportunity Before Create & Update Flow #35885: CRM: Decommission Flows on Opportunity(#22895 Updating the IMGA Account field on Opportunity to populate it on Deal Review).
IMICC9S-2037: Added Multi-BU Flag auto-recalculation. Counts the 5 BU checkboxes (ALM, RIM, Digital, W&L, MAS) and sets Multi_BU_Flag__c to true when 2 or more are checked, false otherwise.
IMICC9S-2044: Added Primary Transaction EAA sync at the very start of the flow (before all other logic, including the Multi-BU recalculation above). When LGK__PrimaryTransactionId__c is populated and changed, copies the linked Transaction's 5 BU EAA fields onto the Opportunity as-is and syncs the corresponding BU checkboxes (checked when > 0, unchecked otherwise).
IMICC9S-2047: Added Primary Business Unit and Primary Product Line derivation, chained right after the EAA sync above. Whenever a Primary Transaction is linked and any of the Opportunity's 5 EAA fields have changed, sets Business_Unit__c to whichever BU has the highest EAA value (tie-broken ALM, RIM, Digital, W&L, MAS), then sets Primary_Product_Line__c from the highest-TotalPrice OpportunityLineItem whose Product_Business_Unit__c matches that winning BU.
IMICC9S-2052: Added conditional Amount roll-up at the very end of the flow (after the Multi-BU logic). When the Opportunity has no Products yet (HasOpportunityLineItem = false), sets Amount to the sum of the 5 EAA fields (blank counts as 0). Once Products exist, this step does nothing and the native Opportunities-with-Products rollup owns Amount.

formulas.description: Gitlab #30528 when opportunity Active Pipeline Indicator (FORMULA) equals Last Year,Future,More than 1 year old or Stage equals Dead,Postponed,Lost then update Active Pipeline equals to False.
formulas.name: ActivePipelineIndicatorFORMULA
formulas.expression:
CASE((VALUE(MID(TEXT({!$Record.CloseDate}),1,4)) - VALUE(MID(TEXT(TODAY()),1,4))),
-1, "Last Year", 0, "Current Year", 1, "Next Year", 2, "Future", 3, "Future", 4, "Future", 5, "Future", "More than 1 year old")
